public import env = "./environment.qui"

int first_max(int[] values)
    best := 0
    for: 1 <= index < int(#values)
        if values[index] > values[best]
            best = index
    return best

int bellman(env.Environment world_model, int[] values, int gamma, int state, int action)
    total := 0
    for transition := world_model.transitions[state][action][]
        target := world_model.world.state_index[transition.cell]
        future := if target < 0 then 0 else env.floor_div(gamma * values[target], 100)
        total += transition.numerator * (10000 * world_model.reward(transition.cell) + future)
    return env.floor_div(total, world_model.slip_total)

int[] actions(env.Environment world_model, int[] values, int gamma, int state)
    int[] result := []
    for: action < 4
        result = result.append(bellman(world_model, values, gamma, state, action))
    return result

int[] greedy_policy(env.Environment world_model, int[] values, int gamma)
    int[] result := []
    for: state < int(#values)
        result = result.append(first_max(actions(world_model, values, gamma, state)))
    return result

class Iteration(int[] values, int[] changes)
class Evaluation(int[] values, int sweeps)
class Round(int sweeps, int changes, int value)
class PolicyIteration(int[] policy, int[] values, Round[] rounds)

Iteration value_iteration(env.Environment world_model, int gamma, int theta)
    values := array(#world_model.world.states, fill = 0)
    int[] changes := []
    delta := theta + 1
    while delta > theta
        int[] updated := []
        delta = 0
        for: state < int(#values)
            value := env.maximum(actions(world_model, values, gamma, state))
            difference := env.absolute(value - values[state])
            if difference > delta
                delta = difference
            updated = updated.append(value)
        changes = changes.append(delta)
        values = updated
    return Iteration(values, changes)

Evaluation in_place(env.Environment world_model, int gamma, int theta)
    values := array(#world_model.world.states, fill = 0)
    sweeps := 0
    delta := theta + 1
    while delta > theta
        sweeps += 1
        delta = 0
        for: state < int(#values)
            value := env.maximum(actions(world_model, values, gamma, state))
            difference := env.absolute(value - values[state])
            if difference > delta
                delta = difference
            values[state] = value
    return Evaluation(values, sweeps)

Evaluation evaluate(env.Environment world_model, int[] policy, int[] initial, int gamma, int theta)
    values := initial
    sweeps := 0
    delta := theta + 1
    while delta > theta
        sweeps += 1
        delta = 0
        for: state < int(#policy)
            value := bellman(world_model, values, gamma, state, policy[state])
            difference := env.absolute(value - values[state])
            if difference > delta
                delta = difference
            values[state] = value
    return Evaluation(values, sweeps)

PolicyIteration policy_iteration(env.Environment world_model, int gamma, int theta)
    policy := array(#world_model.world.states, fill = 0)
    values := array(#policy, fill = 0)
    Round[] rounds := []
    changed := 1
    while changed > 0
        evaluation := evaluate(world_model, policy, values, gamma, theta)
        values = evaluation.values
        int[] improved := []
        changed = 0
        for: state < int(#policy)
            action := first_max(actions(world_model, values, gamma, state))
            improved = improved.append(action)
            if action != policy[state]
                changed += 1
        rounds = rounds.append(Round(evaluation.sweeps, changed, values[world_model.world.start_state]))
        policy = improved
    return PolicyIteration(policy, values, rounds)

int floor_div(int numerator, int denominator)
    return if numerator >= 0 then numerator / denominator else -((-numerator + denominator - 1) / denominator)

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

int maximum(int[] values)
    best := values[0]
    for value := values[]
        if value > best
            best = value
    return best

int total(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

string[] read_lines(string path)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := content.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

class World(int rows, int cols, string kinds, int[] wind, int[] rewards)
    int[] states := []
    int[] terminals := []
    state_index := array(#kinds, fill = -1)
    terminal_index := array(#kinds, fill = -1)
    start := -1
    for: cell < int(#kinds)
        local kind := kinds[cell]
        if kind == "G" or kind == "P"
            terminal_index[cell] = int(#terminals)
            terminals = terminals.append(cell)
        elif kind != "#"
            state_index[cell] = int(#states)
            states = states.append(cell)
            if kind == "S"
                start = cell
    start_state := state_index[start]

    bool terminal(int cell)
        return terminal_index[cell] >= 0

    string ending(int cell)
        return if kinds[cell] == "G" then "goal" else "pit"

    int move(int cell, int direction)
        offsets := [-cols, 1, cols, -1]
        target := cell + offsets[direction]
        if kinds[target] == "#"
            target = cell
        if terminal(target)
            return target
        for _ < wind[cell % cols]
            above := target - cols
            if kinds[above] == "#"
                break
            target = above
            if terminal(target)
                break
        return target

World read_world(string path)
    lines := read_lines(path)
    rows := int(lines[0].split(" ")[1])
    cols := int(lines[1].split(" ")[1])
    kinds := lines[2:<2 + rows].join("")
    digits := lines[2 + rows].split(" ")[1]
    int[] wind := []
    for: index < int(#digits)
        wind = wind.append(int(digits[index]))
    int[] rewards := [for value := lines[3 + rows].split(" ")[1:][] then int(value)]
    return World(rows, cols, kinds, wind, rewards)

class Generator(int value)
    int .draw()
        value = 48271 * value % 2147483647
        return value

class Transition(int cell, int numerator)
class Step(int cell, int reward)

class Environment(World world, int step_reward, int slip_total, int floor_slip, int ice_slip)
    int[][] moves := []
    Transition[][][] transitions := []
    for: state < int(#world.states)
        local int[] row := []
        for: direction < 4
            row = row.append(world.move(world.states[state], direction))
        moves = moves.append(row)
        local Transition[][] actions := []
        local p := if world.kinds[world.states[state]] == "~" then ice_slip else floor_slip
        for: action < 4
            local directions := [action, (action + 1) % 4, (action + 3) % 4]
            local weights := [slip_total - 2 * p, p, p]
            local Transition[] outcomes := []
            for: index < 3
                if weights[index] > 0
                    outcomes = outcomes.append(Transition(row[directions[index]], weights[index]))
            actions = actions.append(outcomes)
        transitions = transitions.append(actions)

    int reward(int cell)
        index := world.terminal_index[cell]
        return if index < 0 then step_reward else world.rewards[index]

    Step step(Generator &generator, int state, int action)
        draw := .generator.draw() % slip_total
        p := if world.kinds[world.states[state]] == "~" then ice_slip else floor_slip
        direction := if draw < slip_total - 2 * p then action elif draw < slip_total - p then (action + 1) % 4 else (action + 3) % 4
        cell := moves[state][direction]
        return Step(cell, reward(cell))

import report = "./report.qui"

int floor_div(int numerator, int denominator)
    return report.mc.td.dp.env.floor_div(numerator, denominator)

int absolute(int value)
    return report.mc.td.dp.env.absolute(value)

int maximum(int[] values)
    return report.mc.td.dp.env.maximum(values)

int total(int[] values)
    return report.mc.td.dp.env.total(values)

int first_max(int[] values)
    return report.mc.td.dp.first_max(values)

int[] zeros(int count)
    return array(nat(count), fill = 0)

int[][] matrix(int count)
    return array(nat(count), fill = array(4, fill = 0))

int agreements(int[] first, int[] second)
    count := 0
    for: index < int(#first)
        if first[index] == second[index]
            count += 1
    return count

class Pair(int first, int second)

Pair[] pairs_of(int[] numbers)
    Pair[] pairs := []
    for: index < int(#numbers) step 2
        pairs = pairs.append(Pair(numbers[index], numbers[index + 1]))
    return pairs

class Settings(local int[][] rows)
    gamma := rows[0][0]
    step_reward := rows[1][0]
    slip_total := rows[2][0]
    floor_slip := rows[2][1]
    ice_slip := rows[2][2]
    theta := rows[3][0]
    gamma_sweep := rows[4]
    slip_sweep := pairs_of(rows[5])
    episodes := rows[6][0]
    step_limit := rows[7][0]
    block_size := rows[8][0]
    alpha := pairs_of(rows[9])
    epsilon := pairs_of(rows[10])
    planning_steps := rows[11][0]
    seed := rows[12][0]
    rollouts := rows[13][0]
    rollout_seed := rows[14][0]

Settings read_settings()
    int[][] rows := []
    for line := report.mc.td.dp.env.read_lines("input/params.txt")[]
        rows = rows.append([for value := line.split(" ")[1:][] then int(value)])
    return Settings(rows)

int schedule_value(Pair[] schedule, int episode)
    value := schedule[0].second
    for entry := schedule[]
        if entry.first <= episode
            value = entry.second
    return value

class Counts(goal := 0, pit := 0, timeout := 0)
    void .add(string ending)
        if ending == "goal"
            goal += 1
        elif ending == "pit"
            pit += 1
        else
            timeout += 1

class Episode(int start)
    sum := 0
    steps := 0
    ending := "timeout"
    cells := [start]

class Block(int agree, int mean_error, int coverage, int sum, int steps, Counts counts)

class Learner(string method, int states)
    q := matrix(states)
    visits := matrix(states)
    dyna := report.mc.td.Model(states)
    averages := report.mc.Averages(states)
    Episode[] episodes := []
    Block[] blocks := []
    int[] policy := []
    int[] state_visits := []
    int[] block_totals := []

    void .learn(report.mc.td.dp.env.Environment world_model, Settings settings, int[] optimal_values, int[] optimal_policy)
        generator := report.mc.td.dp.env.Generator(settings.seed)
        for: 1 <= number <= settings.episodes
            alpha := schedule_value(settings.alpha, number)
            epsilon := schedule_value(settings.epsilon, number)
            episode := Episode(world_model.world.start)
            state := world_model.world.start_state
            report.mc.Visit[] history := []
            action := if method == "sarsa" then report.mc.td.choose(&generator, q[state], epsilon) else 0
            while episode.steps < settings.step_limit
                if method != "sarsa"
                    action = report.mc.td.choose(&generator, q[state], epsilon)
                outcome := world_model.step(&generator, state, action)
                next_state := world_model.world.state_index[outcome.cell]
                visits[state][action] += 1
                episode.sum += outcome.reward
                episode.steps += 1
                episode.cells = episode.cells.append(outcome.cell)
                if method == "mc"
                    history = history.append(report.mc.Visit(state, action, outcome.reward))
                else
                    value := 0
                    next_action := action
                    if next_state >= 0
                        if method == "sarsa"
                            next_action = report.mc.td.choose(&generator, q[next_state], epsilon)
                            value = q[next_state][next_action]
                        elif method == "expected_sarsa"
                            value = report.mc.td.expected(q[next_state], epsilon)
                        else
                            value = maximum(q[next_state])
                    backup := report.mc.td.target(outcome.reward, next_state < 0, value, settings.gamma)
                    report.mc.td.update(&q, state, action, backup, alpha)
                    if method == "sarsa"
                        action = next_action
                    if method == "dyna_q"
                        .dyna.record(state, action, outcome.reward, next_state)
                        dyna.plan(&generator, &q, settings.gamma, alpha, settings.planning_steps)
                if next_state < 0
                    episode.ending = world_model.world.ending(outcome.cell)
                    break
                state = next_state
            if method == "mc"
                .averages.update(&q, history, settings.gamma)
            episodes = episodes.append(episode)
            if number % settings.block_size == 0
                agree := 0
                mean_error := 0
                coverage := 0
                for: index < states
                    if first_max(q[index]) == optimal_policy[index]
                        agree += 1
                    mean_error += absolute(maximum(q[index]) - optimal_values[index])
                    if total(visits[index]) > 0
                        coverage += 1
                sum := 0
                steps := 0
                counts := Counts()
                for: number - settings.block_size <= index < number
                    sum += episodes[index].sum
                    steps += episodes[index].steps
                    .counts.add(episodes[index].ending)
                blocks = blocks.append(Block(agree, floor_div(mean_error, states), coverage, sum, steps, counts))
                block_totals = block_totals.append(sum)
        policy = [for row := q[] then first_max(row)]
        state_visits = [for row := visits[] then total(row)]

class Path(string ending, int[] cells)

Path nominal_path(report.mc.td.dp.env.Environment world_model, int[] policy, int origin, int limit)
    cells := [origin]
    seen := array(#world_model.world.kinds, fill = false)
    seen[origin] = true
    while int(#cells) - 1 < limit
        state := world_model.world.state_index[cells[-1]]
        target := world_model.moves[state][policy[state]]
        repeated := seen[target]
        cells = cells.append(target)
        seen[target] = true
        if world_model.world.terminal(target)
            return Path(world_model.world.ending(target), cells)
        if repeated
            return Path("loop", cells)
    return Path("limit", cells)

int[] distances(report.mc.td.dp.env.Environment world_model)
    result := array(#world_model.world.kinds, fill = -1)
    frontier := [world_model.world.start]
    result[world_model.world.start] = 0
    level := 0
    while #frontier != 0
        level += 1
        int[] following := []
        for cell := frontier[]
            state := world_model.world.state_index[cell]
            for transitions := world_model.transitions[state][]
                for entry := transitions[]
                    if result[entry.cell] < 0
                        result[entry.cell] = level
                        if not world_model.world.terminal(entry.cell)
                            following = following.append(entry.cell)
        frontier = following
    return result

int[] absorption(report.mc.td.dp.env.Environment world_model, int[] policy, int limit)
    count := int(#policy)
    goal := zeros(count)
    pit := zeros(count)
    expected := zeros(count)
    for _ < limit
        int[] next_goal := []
        int[] next_pit := []
        int[] next_expected := []
        for: state < count
            g := 0
            p := 0
            e := 0
            for entry := world_model.transitions[state][policy[state]][]
                target := world_model.world.state_index[entry.cell]
                if target >= 0
                    g += entry.numerator * goal[target]
                    p += entry.numerator * pit[target]
                    e += entry.numerator * expected[target]
                elif world_model.world.kinds[entry.cell] == "G"
                    g += entry.numerator * 100000000
                else
                    p += entry.numerator * 100000000
            next_goal = next_goal.append(floor_div(g, world_model.slip_total))
            next_pit = next_pit.append(floor_div(p, world_model.slip_total))
            next_expected = next_expected.append(100000000 + floor_div(e, world_model.slip_total))
        goal = next_goal
        pit = next_pit
        expected = next_expected
    start := world_model.world.start_state
    return [goal[start], pit[start], 100000000 - goal[start] - pit[start], expected[start]]

class Behaviour(int value, int sweeps)

Behaviour behaviour(report.mc.td.dp.env.Environment world_model, int[] policy, int epsilon, int gamma, int theta)
    values := zeros(int(#policy))
    sweeps := 0
    delta := theta + 1
    while delta > theta
        sweeps += 1
        delta = 0
        for: state < int(#policy)
            backups := report.mc.td.dp.actions(world_model, values, gamma, state)
            sum := 0
            for: action < 4
                weight := epsilon + (if action == policy[state] then 4 * (1000 - epsilon) else 0)
                sum += weight * backups[action]
            value := floor_div(sum, 4000)
            difference := absolute(value - values[state])
            if difference > delta
                delta = difference
            values[state] = value
    return Behaviour(values[world_model.world.start_state], sweeps)

class Rollouts(int terminals)
    int[] returns := []
    int[] discounted := []
    int[] steps := []
    string[] endings := []
    terminal_counts := zeros(terminals)

Rollouts perform_rollouts(report.mc.td.dp.env.Environment world_model, int[] policy, Settings settings)
    generator := report.mc.td.dp.env.Generator(settings.rollout_seed)
    result := Rollouts(int(#world_model.world.terminals))
    for _ < settings.rollouts
        state := world_model.world.start_state
        int[] rewards := []
        ending := "timeout"
        while int(#rewards) < settings.step_limit
            outcome := world_model.step(&generator, state, policy[state])
            rewards = rewards.append(outcome.reward)
            state = world_model.world.state_index[outcome.cell]
            if state < 0
                ending = world_model.world.ending(outcome.cell)
                result.terminal_counts[world_model.world.terminal_index[outcome.cell]] += 1
                break
        result.returns = result.returns.append(total(rewards))
        result.discounted = result.discounted.append(report.mc.discounted(rewards, settings.gamma))
        result.steps = result.steps.append(int(#rewards))
        result.endings = result.endings.append(ending)
    return result

class PolicyEvaluation(int[] values, int sweeps, int agree, int optimal, int gap, int gap_state, int changed, int improved_start, int improved_agree, int[] absorption_values, Rollouts rollouts)

PolicyEvaluation evaluate_policy(report.mc.td.dp.env.Environment world_model, Settings settings, int[] policy, int[] optimal_values, int[] optimal_policy, int[][] optimal_actions)
    evaluation := report.mc.td.dp.evaluate(world_model, policy, zeros(int(#policy)), settings.gamma, settings.theta)
    int[] gaps := []
    optimal := 0
    for: state < int(#policy)
        gaps = gaps.append(optimal_values[state] - evaluation.values[state])
        for action := optimal_actions[state][]
            if action == policy[state]
                optimal += 1
    gap_state := first_max(gaps)
    improved := report.mc.td.dp.greedy_policy(world_model, evaluation.values, settings.gamma)
    second := report.mc.td.dp.evaluate(world_model, improved, zeros(int(#policy)), settings.gamma, settings.theta)
    start := world_model.world.start_state
    return PolicyEvaluation(evaluation.values, evaluation.sweeps, agreements(policy, optimal_policy), optimal, gaps[gap_state], gap_state, int(#policy) - agreements(improved, policy), second.values[start], agreements(improved, optimal_policy), absorption(world_model, policy, settings.step_limit), perform_rollouts(world_model, policy, settings))

string state_text(report.mc.td.dp.env.World world, int state)
    return report.cell(world, world.states[state])

string sensitivity(report.mc.td.dp.env.Environment world_model, int gamma, int theta, int limit, int[] optimal_policy)
    iteration := report.mc.td.dp.value_iteration(world_model, gamma, theta)
    policy := report.mc.td.dp.greedy_policy(world_model, iteration.values, gamma)
    path := nominal_path(world_model, policy, world_model.world.start, limit)
    differences := int(#policy) - agreements(policy, optimal_policy)
    return "iterations {#iteration.changes} value_start " + report.fixed(iteration.values[world_model.world.start_state]) + " path {path.ending} steps {int(#path.cells) - 1} last " + report.cell(world_model.world, path.cells[-1]) + " differences {differences}"

Counts ending_counts(string[] endings)
    counts := Counts()
    for ending := endings[]
        .counts.add(ending)
    return counts

string[] methods()
    return ["mc", "sarsa", "q_learning", "expected_sarsa", "dyna_q"]

world := report.mc.td.dp.env.read_world("input/world.txt")
settings := read_settings()
world_model := report.mc.td.dp.env.Environment(world, settings.step_reward, settings.slip_total, settings.floor_slip, settings.ice_slip)
states := int(#world.states)
start := world.start_state
iteration := report.mc.td.dp.value_iteration(world_model, settings.gamma, settings.theta)
optimal_values := iteration.values
int[][] optimal_q := []
int[] optimal_policy := []
int[][] optimal_actions := []
for: state < states
    row := report.mc.td.dp.actions(world_model, optimal_values, settings.gamma, state)
    optimal_q = optimal_q.append(row)
    optimal_policy = optimal_policy.append(first_max(row))
    best := maximum(row)
    int[] actions := []
    for: action < 4
        if row[action] == best
            actions = actions.append(action)
    optimal_actions = optimal_actions.append(actions)
in_place := report.mc.td.dp.in_place(world_model, settings.gamma, settings.theta)
policy_iteration := report.mc.td.dp.policy_iteration(world_model, settings.gamma, settings.theta)
Learner[] learners := []
policies := [optimal_policy, policy_iteration.policy]
policy_names := ["value_iteration", "policy_iteration"].concat(methods())
for method := methods()[]
    learner := Learner(method, states)
    .learner.learn(world_model, settings, optimal_values, optimal_policy)
    learners = learners.append(learner)
    policies = policies.append(learner.policy)
evaluations := [for policy := policies[] then evaluate_policy(world_model, settings, policy, optimal_values, optimal_policy, optimal_actions)]
distance := distances(world_model)
reachable := int(#[for cell := world.states[] if distance[cell] >= 0 then cell])
walls := 0
floors := 0
ice := 0
goals := 0
pits := 0
for: cell < int(#world.kinds)
    kind := world.kinds[cell]
    if kind == "#"
        walls += 1
    elif kind == "." or kind == "S"
        floors += 1
    elif kind == "~"
        ice += 1
    elif kind == "G"
        goals += 1
    else
        pits += 1
world_lines := ["world rows {world.rows} cols {world.cols} states {states} walls {walls} floor {floors} ice {ice} goals {goals} pits {pits}", "start " + report.cell(world, world.start) + " reachable {reachable}"]
for: index < int(#world.terminals)
    cell := world.terminals[index]
    steps := if distance[cell] < 0 then "-" else "{distance[cell]}"
    world_lines = world_lines.append("terminal " + report.cell(world, cell) + " " + world.ending(cell) + " reward {world.rewards[index]} distance {steps}")
iteration_lines := ["value_iteration gamma {settings.gamma} theta " + report.fixed(settings.theta) + " iterations {#iteration.changes}"]
for: index < int(#iteration.changes)
    iteration_lines = iteration_lines.append("iteration {index + 1} max_change " + report.fixed(iteration.changes[index]))
string[] tied := []
letters := "NESW"
for: state < states
    actions := optimal_actions[state]
    if #actions > 1
        text := [for action := actions[] then letters[action]].join("")
        tied = tied.append("tie " + state_text(world, state) + " " + text)
mirror_pairs := 0
equal_values := 0
mirrored_actions := 0
mirror := [0, 3, 2, 1]
for: state < states
    cell := world.states[state]
    column := cell % world.cols
    other_column := world.cols - 1 - column
    other := world.state_index[cell / world.cols * world.cols + other_column]
    if column < other_column and other >= 0
        mirror_pairs += 1
        if optimal_values[state] == optimal_values[other]
            equal_values += 1
        if optimal_policy[other] == mirror[optimal_policy[state]]
            mirrored_actions += 1
ties_lines := ["ties {#tied}"].concat(tied).append("symmetry pairs {mirror_pairs} equal_values {equal_values} mirrored_actions {mirrored_actions}")
round_lines := ["policy_iteration rounds {#policy_iteration.rounds}"]
total_sweeps := 0
for: index < int(#policy_iteration.rounds)
    round := policy_iteration.rounds[index]
    total_sweeps += round.sweeps
    round_lines = round_lines.append("round {index + 1} sweeps {round.sweeps} changed {round.changes} value_start " + report.fixed(round.value))
int[] differences := []
for: state < states
    differences = differences.append(absolute(policy_iteration.values[state] - optimal_values[state]))
worst := first_max(differences)
comparison_lines := ["comparison policy_differences {states - agreements(policy_iteration.policy, optimal_policy)} max_value_difference " + report.fixed(differences[worst]) + " at " + state_text(world, worst), "backups value_iteration {int(#iteration.changes) * states * 4} in_place_iterations {in_place.sweeps} in_place {in_place.sweeps * states * 4} policy_iteration {total_sweeps * states + int(#policy_iteration.rounds) * states * 4}"]
gamma_lines := ["gamma_sweep"]
for gamma := settings.gamma_sweep[]
    gamma_lines = gamma_lines.append("gamma {gamma} " + sensitivity(world_model, gamma, settings.theta, settings.step_limit, optimal_policy))
slip_lines := ["slip_sweep"]
for slip := settings.slip_sweep[]

public import td = "./td_learning.qui"

int discounted(int[] rewards, int gamma)
    value := 0
    for reward := rewards[::-1][]
        value = 10000 * reward + td.dp.env.floor_div(gamma * value, 100)
    return value

class Visit(int state, int action, int reward)

class Averages(int states)
    int[][] sums := array(nat(states), fill = array(4, fill = 0))
    int[][] counts := array(nat(states), fill = array(4, fill = 0))

    void .update(int[][] &values, Visit[] history, int gamma)
        seen := array(nat(states), fill = array(4, fill = false))
        bool[] first := []
        for visit := history[]
            first = first.append(not seen[visit.state][visit.action])
            seen[visit.state][visit.action] = true
        value := 0
        for: offset < int(#history)
            index := int(#history) - 1 - offset
            visit := history[index]
            value = 10000 * visit.reward + td.dp.env.floor_div(gamma * value, 100)
            if first[index]
                sums[visit.state][visit.action] += value
                counts[visit.state][visit.action] += 1
                values[visit.state][visit.action] = td.dp.env.floor_div(sums[visit.state][visit.action], counts[visit.state][visit.action])

public import mc = "./monte_carlo.qui"

string fixed(int value)
    magnitude := mc.td.dp.env.absolute(value)
    sign := if value < 0 then "-" else ""
    return sign + "{magnitude / 10000}.{magnitude % 10000:04.}"

string average(int sum, int count)
    return fixed(mc.td.dp.env.floor_div(10000 * sum, count))

string cell(mc.td.dp.env.World world, int value)
    return "{value / world.cols},{value % world.cols}"

string cells(mc.td.dp.env.World world, int[] positions)
    return [for value := positions[] then cell(world, value)].join(" ")

string[] grid(mc.td.dp.env.World world, string[] fields, string separator)
    string[] lines := []
    for: int row < world.rows
        string[] parts := []
        for: int column < world.cols
            position := row * world.cols + column
            state := world.state_index[position]
            parts = parts.append(if state < 0 then world.kinds[position] else fields[state])
        lines = lines.append(parts.join(separator))
    return lines

string[] values(mc.td.dp.env.World world, int[] numbers)
    return grid(world, [for value := numbers[] then fixed(value)], " ")

string[] policy(mc.td.dp.env.World world, int[] actions)
    symbols := "^>v<"
    return grid(world, [for action := actions[] then symbols[action]], "")

string[] q_rows(mc.td.dp.env.World world, string name, int[][] q, int[][] visits, optimal := false)
    string[] lines := []
    letters := "NESW"
    for: state < int(#world.states)
        position := world.states[state]
        for: action < 4
            count := if optimal then "-" else "{visits[state][action]}"
            lines = lines.append("{name},{position / world.cols},{position % world.cols},{letters[action]}," + fixed(q[state][action]) + "," + count)
    return lines

string[] join_parts(string[][] parts)
    string[] lines := []
    for: index < int(#parts)
        if index > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(parts[index])
    return lines

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

public import dp = "./dynamic_programming.qui"

int choose(dp.env.Generator &generator, int[] values, int epsilon)
    if .generator.draw() % 1000 < epsilon
        return .generator.draw() % 4
    return dp.first_max(values)

int target(int reward, bool terminal, int value, int gamma)
    return 10000 * reward + (if terminal then 0 else dp.env.floor_div(gamma * value, 100))

int expected(int[] values, int epsilon)
    return dp.env.floor_div(epsilon * dp.env.total(values) + 4 * (1000 - epsilon) * dp.env.maximum(values), 4000)

void update(int[][] &values, int state, int action, int target_value, int alpha)
    values[state][action] += dp.env.floor_div(alpha * (target_value - values[state][action]), 100)

class Outcome(int state, int action, int reward, int next_state)

class Model(int states)
    int[][] positions := array(nat(states), fill = array(4, fill = -1))
    Outcome[] outcomes := []

    void .record(int state, int action, int reward, int next_state)
        index := positions[state][action]
        if index < 0
            positions[state][action] = int(#outcomes)
            outcomes = outcomes.append(Outcome(state, action, reward, next_state))
        else
            outcomes[index] = Outcome(state, action, reward, next_state)

    void plan(dp.env.Generator &generator, int[][] &values, int gamma, int alpha, int steps)
        for _ < steps
            index := .generator.draw() % int(#outcomes)
            outcome := outcomes[index]
            value := if outcome.next_state < 0 then 0 else dp.env.maximum(values[outcome.next_state])
            backup := target(outcome.reward, outcome.next_state < 0, value, gamma)
            update(&values, outcome.state, outcome.action, backup, alpha)
